description: This file is a unit test class for the DestroyPurgeStrategy component of the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It sets up testing for deleting entities (specifically EmpPicture) associated with an employee, verifying the purge functionality.

classes.name: DestroyPurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the DestroyPurgeStrategy's purge method, ensuring it correctly deletes related EmpPicture entities for a given employee.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DestroyPurgeStrategy instance and populates test data from a fixture before each test.

methods.name: testPurge
methods.description: Tests that the purge method correctly deletes EmpPicture entities linked to employee ID 1.
